howToUpdateWithinHours: Edit data/season-guides/flytime-fest-2026.json only — do not invent artists, prices, or dates.

When an organiser page or named Tier-1 report confirms a headliner: add { name, sourceUrl, sourceLabel, sourceId } under the matching night.artists, set lineupIncomplete false when that night is fully named, and prepend a changelog entry with ISO date at and the source URL.
If Fest or Circle dates change on an organiser page, update when and summaryOnFile to match that page, then run npm run ingest:events and refresh the matching seed/published rows.
Keep lineupStatus incomplete until every night on this tracker has at least one sourced artist (or an organiser statement that the night is cancelled).
Deploy by committing to main (Vercel). Changelog at the top of the page is the public audit trail.
